# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

**Champion retains crown** — last candidate traded lockbox stability for worse tuning min and deeper drawdown.

## Runloop Health
```
✓ 435 loops completed
✓ No INCONCLUSIVE backlog
⏱ ~77 min remaining
```

## Recommendation

With limited time remaining, prioritize **exploitation over exploration**:

```bash
# Run in order — stop if time runs short after step 1
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
    --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
    --run --select-best

# Only if >40 min remain
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
    --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
    --run

# Generate report regardless (fast)
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
    --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
    --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

**Key focus**: The champion's tuning min (0.43) and worst MDD (-9.3%) are solid. Future candidates should target lockbox min improvement *without* sacrificing these.

Ready to continue or need adjustments to the approach?
